title: Ali's English Class
setting: A bright classroom in a school.

characters.name: Ali
characters.look: Ali, a young boy with short black hair and a blue shirt

characters.name: Rosa
characters.look: Rosa, a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow sweater

characters.name: Teacher
characters.look: the teacher, a kind woman with glasses and a white shirt

sentences.en: Ali is a beginner in this English course.
sentences.zh: 阿里是这门英语课程的初学者。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ali, a young boy with short black hair and a blue shirt sits at a desk in a bright classroom with an English book.

sentences.en: His class has English at school every morning.
sentences.zh: 他们班每天早上在学校上英语课。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ali, a young boy with short black hair and a blue shirt and Rosa, a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow sweater sit with other children in a school classroom in the morning sun.

sentences.en: The teacher stands at the blackboard with chalk.
sentences.zh: 老师拿着粉笔站在黑板前。
sentences.scene_prompt: the teacher, a kind woman with glasses and a white shirt stands at a big blackboard holding a piece of chalk.

sentences.en: Ali draws lines on paper with his ruler.
sentences.zh: 阿里用尺子在纸上画线。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ali, a young boy with short black hair and a blue shirt draws straight lines on a white sheet of paper with a ruler.

sentences.en: Then he writes the new words in his notebook.
sentences.zh: 然后他把新单词写进笔记本。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ali, a young boy with short black hair and a blue shirt writes carefully in an open notebook on his desk.

sentences.en: Rosa helps him study and spell the words.
sentences.zh: 罗莎帮他学习和拼写这些单词。
sentences.scene_prompt: Rosa, a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow sweater points at Ali, a young boy with short black hair and a blue shirt's notebook and helps him, both smiling.

sentences.en: Ali wants to learn every word for the exam.
sentences.zh: 阿里想为考试学会每一个单词。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ali, a young boy with short black hair and a blue shirt reads his notebook with a serious face, Rosa, a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow sweater beside him.

sentences.en: If he does well, his holiday is in Rome.
sentences.zh: 如果他考得好，他就去罗马度假。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ali, a young boy with short black hair and a blue shirt dreams of a holiday in Rome, a picture of an old Roman building in a thought bubble.
